PackageData0.Name: FpRdap
PackageData0.CommunityDescription: RDAP client library for Free Pascal: domain/IP/autnum/entity queries (RFC 9082/9083) routed via official IANA bootstrap files (RFC 8524/9224/9225), with IDNA punycode conversion of U-label domains (via fp-idn), RFC 9083 error-object parsing, Retry-After handling, response size limits, and a built-in mock client for offline unit tests.
